name: com.chessvox/chessvox
title: ChessVox
description: Free chess tools for AI agents: Stockfish best move, evaluation, openings and game analysis.

tools.name: best_move
tools.description: Stockfish 19's best move, evaluation and main line for a chess position (FEN). Score is from the side to move's point of view.

fen.description: FEN of the position, e.g. "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1".

tools.name: opening_info
tools.description: Look up one of the 50 most played chess openings by ECO code (B12) or name (London System): main line, starting FEN, plans and a guide link.

tools.name: elo_change
tools.description: Rating change for a win, draw or loss: FIDE Elo, or Glicko-1 estimates for Chess.com and Lichess.

k.description: FIDE K-factor (10, 20 or 40). Default from your rating.

tools.name: daily_puzzle
tools.description: Today's free ChessVox daily puzzle: position, rating and solution in UCI.
